# Matrix Agent Tools

> Specialized pay-per-job services for autonomous AI agents.

## Connection

- MCP endpoint: https://agents.matrixdigitalltd.com/v1/agent/mcp
- Registry identity: com.matrixdigitalltd/agent-tools
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Payment protocol: x402
- Network: Base Sepolia
- Environment: Testnet preview

## Available discovery tools

- matrix_catalogue: discover services and availability.
- matrix_quote: request a commercial quotation.
- matrix_job_status: retrieve authorized job status.

## Product portfolio

- Deployment Guard
- Commerce Guard
- Ad Tracking Guard
- Checkout Monitor
- Tender Intelligence
- MCP Security Audit

## Commercial model

Autonomous machine authentication and per-job payment.
No mandatory human subscription for machine services.

Check current route availability before payment.
Mainnet payments are currently disabled.

## Provider

https://matrixdigitalltd.com/

## Integration resources

- Machine-readable service discovery: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/matrixdi/matrix-agent-tools/main/agent-discovery.json
- Agent integration guide: https://github.com/matrixdi/matrix-agent-tools/blob/main/docs/agent-integration.md
